# =============================================================================
#
# Abstract
# --------
# Exact versions of the runtime dependencies of Unbihexium and of the test,
# onnx, serving, zarr and parquet extras, which the test, coverage and
# integration workflows install, plus the dependencies of PyTorch listed in
# requirements-ci-test.in. PyTorch itself is not included: the workflows
# install its CPU build with --no-deps from requirements-ci-torch.txt, which
# the Torch Lock workflow compiles against the PyTorch index. After this file
# the workflows install Unbihexium itself with `pip install --no-deps -e .`.
#
# Every distribution carries its SHA-256 hash; install the file with
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r .github/requirements/requirements-ci-test.txt
# so pip refuses any file that differs from the reviewed one (OpenSSF
# Scorecard, Pinned-Dependencies). One file covers CPython 3.10 to 3.14.
#
# Do not edit the uv output by hand: change the extras in pyproject.toml and run
# `make lock`; `make lock-check` fails when this file is out of date.
#
# The list below is generated by uv. Each entry shows which requirement pulled
# the package in ("via").
# =============================================================================

# This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:
#    make lock
